name: plate-sixup-coconut-breeze
prompt:
Photograph these six products against a plain, flat mint-green backdrop, exactly
the same green as the reference photo.

Arrangement: three lotion bottles standing in a row across the upper half, and
three cream jars standing in a row across the lower half. Nothing overlaps or
touches — every bottle and every jar is fully visible, separated by clear space,
and each one stands on its own base.

Even soft studio lighting, straight-on eye-level camera, no perspective tilt.

Keep every product exactly as in the reference photos: identical labels, identical
wording, identical proportions, identical caps and lids. Do not re-letter anything.
No text, captions, graphics or props anywhere in the image.
